notes: 1.10.3 - IMPORTANT: this update needs NeoForge 21.1.248 (up from 21.1.244). The Forgified Fabric API update in 1.10.0 pulled in modules that require it. If your game will not start with "requires neoforge 21.1.248 or above", reinstall the pack in your launcher rather than using Update Now - the updater cannot change the loader version. Also fixes leftover Fabric jars: LongerChatHistory, More Armor Trims, Dynamic FPS and Continuity all moved to NeoForge builds, and the old Fabric copies are now removed properly instead of sitting alongside them and failing to load. Parachute, Grand Teleport, Camera Overhaul, Zoomify and Simulated Coasters are removed. Everything else from 1.10.x is unchanged: VR support, Customizable Player Models, the Season 2 title screen, the Normal/Potato Mode button, Sable 2.0.5 and Create: Aeronautics 1.3.2.
